jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact MadhuraPangarkjar], Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at madhura.pangarkar@simcorp.com If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

**Shape cyber security across an international industrial organisation

**Would you like to take ownership of the cyber security agenda in a growing international company contributing to the green transition? As Chief Information Security Officer, you will oversee information security across NKT's IT infrastructure, software and cloud services, ensuring our approach reflects evolving cyber threats, regulatory requirements and business needs. You will work with senior stakeholders on cyber risk, compliance and security priorities while developing NKT's information security framework and policies.

**Advance information security, cyber risk and regulatory compliance

**You will take ownership of NKT Group IT security policies and coordinate the continued development of our information and cyber security programme. Working across an international organisation, you will monitor the evolving threat landscape, address cyber risks and ensure alignment with relevant legislation, standards and frameworks, including NIS2, AI-act, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

**Your Responsibility Will Be To

**

• Oversee the IT threat landscape, cyber risks and applicable information security legislation

• Develop, maintain and communicate NKT Group IT security policies

• Monitor compliance with security policies and coordinate relevant follow-up activities

• Develop and manage information and cyber security improvement programmes

• Provide senior stakeholders with clear information on cyber risks, priorities and security status

The position works closely with senior stakeholders across NKT and reports to the CIO. The role included exposure to the Group Leadership Team and Audit Committee.

You will be based at our headquarter in Nordhavn, Copenhagen. Expect 20-25 days of travel per year.

**Experienced Cyber Security Professional With Broad Technology Understanding

**You communicate complex security matters in a clear and practical way and are comfortable working with stakeholders across functions and countries. You are collaborative, structured and able to take ownership of priorities while balancing cyber risk, regulatory requirements and business needs. You are comfortable operating independently while building productive relationships across an international matrix organisation.

**You Also Have

**

• 5–10+ years of experience implementing information security frameworks

• Broad knowledge of cyber security, IT infrastructure, software and cloud services

• Knowledge of NIS2, AI-act, ISO 27001, GDPR and relevant information security regulation and frameworks

• Experience from international, complex organisations and interaction with senior management

• Proven experience developing and communicating IT security policies

• Preferred: ITIL and/or PRINCE2 certification.

**Protecting digital foundations for NKT's greener future

**We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.

This role provides opportunities for career development within a collaborative, international environment where you can continue to grow your cyber security, risk and stakeholder management skills. You will work across functions and countries, contribute to NKT's cyber security agenda and support an international organisation whose purpose is to connect a greener world.

“As a leader, I want our Chief Information Security Officer to combine sound cyber security judgement with a pragmatic understanding of our business. The role is central to maintaining an appropriate security level as NKT continues to grow and our regulatory and technology landscape evolves,” says Hiring Manager, CIO, Niels Keller-Larsen”

Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!

We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 15th of November 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. If you have any questions about the role, you are very welcome to contact Hiring Manager Niels Keller-Larsen at niels.keller-larsen@nkt.com. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Global HR Business Partner, Morten Sponholtz at morten.sponholtz@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.

We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.

Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

**About NKT

**_NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

jobs.occupation: Process Modelling & Simulation Engineer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by turning complex process models into practical engineering decisions and thrive on solving challenging engineering questions through simulation, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Simulation Engineer with industrial experience to join our team of simulation specialists in Early Simulation Insights. As a team, we develop data-driven process models that support the design and optimisation of future API manufacturing facilities.

Your contribution will be important in transforming simulation results into practical engineering decisions that support facility design, capacity planning and utility-system configuration. Working closely with process, utility and modelling specialists, you will evaluate production scenarios, equipment requirements and operational strategies through dynamic simulations.

By testing assumptions and comparing alternatives early in the design process, you will help teams identify constraints, validate solutions and make informed decisions. In addition, you will contribute to the development of the department’s capabilities, methods and ways of working.

How you might spend your days

As a Simulation Engineer you’ll be:

• Building process models to evaluate capacity, utilisation and production schedules

• Assessing equipment configurations, batch strategies and cleaning approaches

• Modelling utility demand to support early facility and utility-system design

• Developing digital twins for early design verification and Virtual C&Q

• Translating simulation results into engineering recommendations with cross-functional specialists

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and motivated to build new knowledge and explore complex engineering questions

• Structured in your approach and able to transform complexity into clear analyses and recommendations

• Open-minded and solution-oriented, with an interest in developing new methods and ways of working

• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across teams, disciplines and stakeholders

• Interested in understanding customer needs and translating technical insights into practical value

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You hold an MSc or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Process Systems Engineering, Simulation or a related discipline

• You have 3-5 years of experience with process modelling or simulation in pharma, biotech or another process industry

• You have hands-on experience with tools such as INOSIM, Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, MATLAB, Python, DWSIM or similar software

• You have a strong understanding of chemical engineering principles and can apply data-driven insights to engineering decision-making

• You are fluent in written and spoken English

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 23rd November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Henriette Schubert at +45 3079 4293.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Alliance Management and Strategic Partnerships
jobs.description:
Does it excite you to work with partners to bring new medicines to the market and to patients, and do you have experience with taking partnerships from early science through to launch? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position

This Senior Director position reports to the SVP for Alliance Management, within a growing area of Commercial. The ambition is to evolve the mandate from ensuring partnerships are well governed and deliver against contractual obligations to maximizing the strategic, scientific and commercial value of our external partnerships across the asset lifecycle: from early science through development, regulatory approval, launch and lifecycle management. As we grow, the position offers the opportunity to build a "partner-to-market" value proposition for the entire organization and to shape the area that delivers it.

We offer exciting responsibilities:

• Shape and drive the partner-to-market agenda, keeping the route to market in focus and contributing to the strategy, operating model and growth of the area

• Lead strategic partnership assessments, from partner identification and deal thesis development to close collaboration with Business Development and the identification of portfolio and capability gaps that partnerships can address

• Maximize the value of partnered assets through strong alliance governance, timely milestone delivery and proactive risk management across the partnership portfolio

• Drive cross-functional alignment between Zealand teams and partners, and resolve escalations and conflicts constructively and swiftly

• Prepare partnerships for commercial success through launch readiness, market access collaborations and co-commercialization models

• Unlock lifecycle expansion opportunities with partners, including new indications that extend the value of Zealand assets

Your profile

You are motivated by the path from molecules to market, and by combining Zealand's strengths with those of our partners to reach patients faster and further. Alliance management experience is a strength, and you have a genuine motivation to drive partnership progress with the patient always in view. You are a strategic and commercially minded partner who builds trust easily, influences without relying on formal authority, and is energized by building something new in a growing organization. Curiosity, resilience and a bold, collaborative approach come naturally to you.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in biopharma or big pharma, within partnering, business development, alliance management, commercial or development roles

• Deep understanding of drug development and commercialization, demonstrated through hands-on experience from regulatory approval, launch readiness, market access or co-commercialization, and the ability to connect early scientific decisions to commercial outcomes

• Strong strategic and commercial acumen, including deal structures, partnership economics and deal thesis development, with the ability to assess where a partnership creates the most value for patients and for Zealand across the asset lifecycle

• Solid understanding of US market dynamics, including pricing, payer and market access considerations that shape partnered commercial strategies

• Solid understanding and experience working with Chinese market is an advantage

• Ability to challenge early science and clinical development programs with the end product in mind, ideally with experience within obesity and metabolic health

Your new team

Alliance Management reports to the Executive Vice President for Commercial and works at the interface between our partners and our internal functions across research, development, regulatory, commercial and business development

Let's bond and be bold

We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than 12 November 2026 or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applications from all job applicants.

About Zealand Pharma A/S

Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced data-driven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. To date, more than ten Zealand Pharma-invented drug candidates have entered clinical development, of which two products have reached the market and three candidates are in late-stage development. The Company has collaborations with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for research, development, and commercialization. Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

jobs.occupation: Associate Digital Product Director – Regulatory Data & AI
jobs.description:
Does it excite you to shape digital products and AI-enabled solutions that make regulatory data flow reliably across the enterprise and on to EMA and FDA, and do you have experience with Veeva Vault RIM? If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position

As Associate Digital Product Director – Regulatory Data & AI, you will drive the evolution of our digital products, enterprise systems and data capabilities, with a primary focus on Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing and opportunities across the wider organization. A key responsibility is the continued development of regulatory data capabilities in Veeva Vault RIM and other connected Vaults, ensuring that product hierarchies and master data are structured consistently and flow reliably across systems and to health authorities. You will act as business owner of regulatory data, working in close partnership with Digital, Data & Technology (DD&T’s) Data Analytics & AI Platforms team. As our pipeline advances towards late-stage submissions and our digital transformation accelerates, you will build the foundations for connected, data-driven and increasingly AI-enabled business processes that are built on trusted data and responsible AI practices.

We offer exciting responsibilities:

• 
Drive digital product strategy and roadmaps aligned with Zealand’s enterprise data and AI strategy, translating business needs into prioritized initiatives that deliver measurable value

• 
Own the product hierarchy and regulatory master data in Veeva Vault RIM as business data owner, ensuring clear stewardship, accuracy, completeness and consistency across the organization

• 
Connect business-critical regulatory data across Veeva RIM, eTMF and Safety Vaults and, together with DD&T, make it available to enterprise platforms and data lakes, in alignment with regulatory data standards (IDMP, SPOR, xEVMPD, eCTD v4.0), GxP and data integrity requirements for EMA and FDA

• 
Explore and assess generative AI, AI agents, intelligent automation and advanced analytics, and turn promising opportunities into practical solutions for Regulatory Affairs and Medical Writing, through governed AI delivery, together with DD&T and business teams

• 
Define and own regulatory data products, APIs, reporting and business intelligence solutions, built on the shared enterprise data platform with DD&T, that make information more accessible, actionable and reusable across functions

• 
Lead system evolution and cross-functional transformation initiatives, including those supporting Medical Writing, from evaluating new releases and capabilities to implementation, validation, change management and post-launch optimization

Your profile

You are a digitally minded product professional who combines business understanding, systems thinking and technological curiosity. You understand the importance of regulatory data and the processes it supports, and you look beyond individual systems to see opportunities across the wider digital ecosystem. You work independently, bring structure to complex initiatives and build trusted relationships across business and technology teams. You are comfortable owning data in the business and you are curious about how AI, automation and modern data platforms can transform the way we work, and you help colleagues build confidence in new ways of working.

• 
Extensive experience in digital product management, business systems or technology transformation, ideally within pharmaceutical, biotech or another regulated industry

• 
Solid understanding of Regulatory Affairs and the product development lifecycle, including CTAs/INDs, eCTD, submissions and lifecycle management

• 
Experience with complex business applications, data models, master data and cross-system integrations; hands-on experience with Veeva Vault RIM is important, and experience with eTMF or Safety Vaults is an advantage

• 
Ability to define product vision, prioritize competing needs and align business, IT, data and external partners around shared outcomes

• 
Familiarity with APIs, data pipelines, data lakes, business intelligence and tools such as Vault Loader, as well as data governance, data ownership and data product concepts, and an interest in generative AI and intelligent automation

• 
Proven ability to lead complex initiatives independently, including integrations, release management in GxP-validated environments, adoption and change management

A few years into RevOps, most people end up choosing between staying close to admin and reporting, or moving towards building automations and the AI tools that now sit on top of the CRM. The second path is hard to get onto if you haven't done it somewhere first.

In this job you'd do both, in a commercial team that already works with AI day to day through assistants connected to Salesforce, support tickets and product data, while marketing is being rebuilt the same way. You'd build on that, starting next to the person who set most of it up and taking over the technical side from them. You'd also keep the CRM and the data underneath it in good order. That's a lot of upkeep, like permissions, data cleanup and renewal notices to thousands of customers, and there's no ops team to share it with.

Airtame makes wireless screen-sharing devices and the cloud software that manages them, used in schools and workplaces around the world. Most of our volume goes through distributors on several continents, sometimes to customers our own reps sent them. Our sales team also works deals directly, and smaller orders come through our Shopify store. Running all three through one Salesforce makes for a harder data model than most RevOps roles come with.

We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and we'd prefer you to work from the office there. Remote from elsewhere in the EU works too. You'd report to our Director of Customer Experience & Revenue Operations, who sets the roadmap with you and owns the metric definitions, and you'd work with sales, customer experience, marketing and product every week.

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)

Own the Commercial Stack: By the end of the year the technical side has moved over to you, including the AI tools the team uses. You bring the roadmap to your manager and build it, and when sales or support want a system changed, you decide how it's done.

Send the Right Renewal Message: Thousands of customers receive renewal notices. We're starting to ask customers in our cloud software how they intend to renew, and you'd build the email flows that act on it, with a separate path for each way of renewing. If a notice doesn't go out, you know within hours.

Make the Numbers Agree: Pipeline, bookings, ARR, renewals and churn come out the same in every dashboard and every AI assistant, whether the sale came through Shopify, a rep or a distributor. Your manager sets the definitions, and you make sure every system uses them.

Automate the Manual Work: Find the processes worth automating and keep shipping them, tested in a sandbox first with a way back if something goes wrong. The first one is turning the pricing claims our distributors send, in all sorts of formats, into line-item pricing in Salesforce with an audit trail. As AI assistants get better at connecting to things on their own, part of this is also deciding what's still worth building ourselves.

Bring Support onto Intercom: We're moving customer support from Zendesk to Intercom. Depending on when you join, you'd help finish the move or pick it up just after go-live, then own Intercom, including its Salesforce sync and the AI setup that gets customer feedback to the product team.

Who You Are

• You know Salesforce from the inside. A few years of hands-on admin, including Flow Builder, permissions and the data model. You write SQL and SOQL and can model data for a report yourself.

• You ask why before you build. You can tell us about a request you pushed back on, or a process you changed or dropped instead of automating it as asked, and what it was for in the first place.

• You work with AI by default. You use AI tools every day to write flows and queries, and you keep up with what's new on your own. When a new connector makes something we built unnecessary, you're happy to retire it. If you've connected tools through their APIs or written some Python or JavaScript, that's a strong plus.

• You've run a commercial system on your own. At some point you've been the only or main admin of a Salesforce org or a similar system, and you left documentation behind that someone else could take over from. Here there's no ops team behind you, so a broken sync in the morning and a dashboard request in the afternoon are both yours.

Why Airtame?

• Building on Top of Admin: You'd keep the CRM running and build automations and AI tooling on top of it, starting next to the person who set most of it up.

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Catered lunch in the office.

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

**Apylon is building agents for the most complex workflow out there - financial admin in healthcare.

• Build reusable integration-platform primitives for extraction, normalisation, versioning, replay, monitoring, and observability.

• Strong data-modelling instincts. You know when abstraction creates leverage and when it hides important real-world variation.

• Comfort working from incomplete information. You form hypotheses, test them against data, and distinguish unknowns that can wait from assumptions that could invalidate the system.

• Confidence in customer-facing technical work: discovery calls, debugging sessions, and direct conversations with vendors and hospital IT teams.
